info.title: Internet.nl Dashboard API
info.description:
## Introduction

This is the dashboard API specification.

 ## Authentication

For authentication you can login via allauth. The allauth swagger file can be found here: `/api/v1/allauth/openapi.html` .

The internet.nl API, which is used inside the dashboard, can be found here: `https://batch.internet.nl/api/batch/openapi.yaml` and can be live-rendered via the following:url `https://redocly.github.io/redoc/?url=https://batch.internet.nl/api/batch/openapi.yaml`.

## Using Swagger

Authenticated `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` and `DELETE` calls in `/api/v1/docs` use the current browser session and CSRF token. First log in in the same browser via `/api/v1/allauth/openapi.html`, then return to `/api/v1/docs` and use `Try it out`.
